source_scope: Initial candidate only; root may repair then require new source binding. No Gazebo, estimator replay, numeric benchmark or throughput pass claimed.

thread_ownership_findings.receiver: Exactly one SingleThreadedExecutor invokes receive_cloud/image/imu/tick; ingress_sequence belongs to receiver.
thread_ownership_findings.mutable_decode_scratch: p_pre process runs only receiver in enabled generic path; owner reads only configuration lidar_type after initialization. GPS/HILTI/disabled sensor modes rejected.
thread_ownership_findings.estimator_owner: Old measurement callbacks and timer execute only commit_ingress on main. Model state/map/sync buffer/current diagnostics context remain main owner.
thread_ownership_findings.queue: Mutex serializes push/pop/stats/fail/close. FIFO capacity failure sticky, main pop fails rather than silently dropping/overwriting accepted history.
thread_ownership_findings.payload_lifetime: Shared original messages kept; decoded image is cloned by existing decoder; per-cloud copy keeps decoder scratch independent.

must_address_before_semantic_pass.issue: receive_image decodes before original duplicate/backward/min_interval checks, so decoder error in an otherwise skipped frame newly fails the run.
must_address_before_semantic_pass.scope: Actual current simulation may only provide valid frames; that does not establish same-input skip/error equivalence.
must_address_before_semantic_pass.suggestion: Capture decoder exception in packet, rethrow only at original owner decode position after unchanged header gates; never prefilter using shared owner last_timestamp. Test malformed duplicate/backward/sub20ms frame.

must_address_before_semantic_pass.issue: kind300 standard_preprocess12 became an empty main-owner scope; spin_some8 now only commit. These are not same measured intervals as V12.
must_address_before_semantic_pass.suggestion: Prospective new stage schema and explicit old12 N/A for active pipeline; instrument receiver decode/queue/owner spans, not call empty time decode speedup.

must_address_before_semantic_pass.issue: CSV receipt/decode-end/commit-start lacks enqueue/dequeue/end, queue watermark per event, worker and owner identities, attempted receive/final exception context.
must_address_before_semantic_pass.suggestion: Read-only per-event sequence/original integer source receipt/receive/decode/enqueue/dequeue/commit-end/queue bytes-count/thread ID and explicit final attempted/accepted/delivered/committed/canceled/rejected identities; missing trace must reject independently.

scope_limits.detail: 512/64MiB bounds ready queue retained payload, not original ROS QoS depth200000/DDS queue nor decoder scratch; report queue limit scope.
FIFO preserves this executor observed callback order. Continuous spin vs spin_some changes dispatch/batch timing; only identical explicit event replay can claim same ordering/numeric output.
First version decodes in receive executor; long decode blocks later IMU/timer receive. No separate receiver/decoder stage yet.
Queued timer executes unchanged original imu_prop_callback on owner, but after queue delay. Actual scheduling/TTL/output rate must be measured; pure queue does not establish end-to-end benefit.
Cancel and join precede owner queue close, pending count retained as canceled. Explicit canceled evidence must remain; no final lossless claim from accepted alone.
